phases.title: CPS Quality Infrastructure — Linter + Simulator
phases.intent: Build automated tools that catch CPS bugs WITHOUT Fusion 360. A scope linter prevents diameter-class crashes. A CPS simulator runs onSection/getFeed logic against mock Fusion API data.

phases.title: Data Validation — Cross-Reference All Databases
phases.intent: Validate every machine, material, and holder in the CPS against PRISM's authoritative registries. Catch spec drift. Verify CORS. Expand G-code test fixtures.

phases.title: PPG Web Page — 5-Step Wizard Build
phases.intent: Refactor the existing 6-tab PPG page into a guided 5-step wizard: Machine → Material → Tools → CAM → Generate. Use WorkspacePrimitives. Dark theme matching calculator.

phases.title: Full Database Wiring — Search + Auto-Fill
phases.intent: Wire the page to PRISM's full databases: 920 machines via machine_search, 6353 materials via material_search, 75K tools via tool_search, 2365 holders. Real-time physics preview on selection.

phases.title: Integration Tests + Final Regression + Ship Readiness
phases.intent: Full E2E tests of the wizard flow. Re-run 20-agent scrutiny on updated CPS. All tests pass. Confidence >= 90.

sessions.title: CPS Quality Infrastructure
sessions.intent: Build tools that prevent CPS bugs automatically. The CPS scope linter parses JavaScript AST and flags undefined variables inside methods. The CPS simulator mocks Fusion 360's API and runs onSection/getFeed against sample tool+material data.
sessions.exit_gate: CPS linter catches the 3 known bugs (diameter, .speed.speed, flutes) in a test-modified CPS. CPS simulator produces G-code from mock operations. Both integrated into vitest.

sessions.title: Data Validation + CORS + Fixtures
sessions.intent: Cross-validate all embedded CPS data against PRISM registries. Verify CORS works for Fusion add-in. Add more real-program test fixtures.
sessions.exit_gate: All 142 CPS machines validated against MachineRegistry. All 185 CPS materials validated against published kc1.1. CORS test passes. 10+ new G-code fixtures added.

sessions.title: PPG Page Shell — 5-Step Wizard + Hero
sessions.intent: Refactor PostProcessorGeneratorPage.tsx from 6-tab layout to 5-step wizard. Steps: Machine → Material → Tools → CAM → Generate. WorkspacePrimitives throughout.
sessions.exit_gate: Page renders at /ppg with 5-step wizard. Navigation between steps works. Hero + SummaryTiles update reactively. Dark theme matches calculator.

sessions.title: Machine + Material Search Panels
sessions.intent: Build MachineSearchPanel (debounced search against 920 machines, auto-fill controller + features) and MaterialSearchPanel (ISO group filter, Kienzle/Taylor display).
sessions.exit_gate: Type 'Haas VF' → results from 920-machine DB. Select → controller auto-fills. Material search with ISO tabs returns from 6353 materials.

sessions.title: Tool + Holder + Physics Preview Panels
sessions.intent: Build ToolConfigCard (search 75K tools, auto-fill), HolderSelectorPanel (2365 holders, TIR/stiffness), real-time S/F preview when machine+material+tool+holder all selected.
sessions.exit_gate: Tool search returns from 75K DB. Holder search shows TIR/stiffness. S/F preview updates on any input change.

sessions.title: CAM Selector + Post Generation + Preview
sessions.intent: CAM package dropdown (8 systems), generate button calling pipeline, G-code preview with syntax highlighting, program upload + optimize + diff view.
sessions.exit_gate: 8 CAM packages selectable. Generate produces valid CPS. Preview renders with highlighting. Upload/optimize/diff works.

sessions.title: E2E Tests — Full Wizard Flow
sessions.intent: Comprehensive E2E tests: wizard flow (3 machines), all 8 CAM packages, upload/optimize/diff, offline fallback. Re-run 5-agent CPS scrutiny.
sessions.exit_gate: 20+ E2E tests pass. All 8 CAMs work. Offline fallback serves 200 materials. CPS scrutiny: 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH.

sessions.title: Final Regression + Ship Readiness Assessment
sessions.intent: Run EVERY test. Update CPS on desktop. Write ship-readiness report with confidence score. Document remaining user-testing tasks.
sessions.exit_gate: All tests pass (target: 1600+). CPS on desktop. Confidence assessment >= 90. Ship-readiness report written.

U-SH01.title: CPS JavaScript scope linter
U-SH01.description: Build a vitest that parses the CPS file's JavaScript AST (using acorn or espree) and checks every function for references to variables not in its parameter list or local scope. Must catch: bare 'diameter' in calculateOptimizedSpeed, 'result.speed.speed' property access, string flutes without fallback. Outputs a list of scope violations.
abort_criteria: Linter produces false positives on valid code
U-SH01.exit_gate: Linter detects all 3 historical bugs in a test-modified CPS. Zero false positives on the current clean CPS.

U-SH02.title: CPS simulator with mock Fusion API
U-SH02.description: Build a Node.js harness that extracts PRISM_PHYSICS from the CPS and runs calculateAll() against mock tool/material/operation data. Mock getProperty(), getParameter(), hasParameter(), tool object, currentSection. Verify output RPM/feed are valid numbers, not NaN. Test 5 material+tool combinations.
abort_criteria: Can't extract PRISM_PHYSICS via vm module
Mock Fusion API diverges from real API
Simulator produces different results than Fusion
U-SH02.exit_gate: Simulator runs 5 material+tool combos. All produce valid RPM/feed. No NaN. Results match hand-calculated expected values within 10%.

U-SH03.title: CPS regression test suite — prevent future crash bugs
U-SH03.description: Expand cps-physics-standalone.test.ts with regression tests for every bug fixed in this sprint: diameter scope, .speed.Vc, flutes fallback, NaN feed, unrounded RPM, HEM speed boost at various ae/D ratios, prove-out derating, TIR-based speed factor. Total: 20+ regression tests.
abort_criteria: New tests don't catch reintroduced bugs
U-SH03.exit_gate: 50+ CPS standalone tests pass. Coverage includes every bug fix from PPG-HARDEN.

U-SH04.title: Cross-validate CPS machineDatabase vs MachineRegistry
U-SH04.description: Write a test that reads every machine from the CPS machineDatabase (142 entries) and compares RPM/HP/torque/taper against MachineRegistry (920 machines). Flag mismatches > 10%. Report discrepancies.
abort_criteria: More than 20% of machines have discrepancies
U-SH04.exit_gate: All 142 CPS machines checked. Discrepancies listed. Major mismatches (>20% on RPM or HP) fixed.

U-SH05.title: Cross-validate CPS materials vs published Kienzle data
U-SH05.description: Write a test that checks every material's kc1.1 and mc against known published values (Sandvik catalog, Machinery's Handbook). Flag materials where kc1.1 differs > 15% from published. Verify all 185 materials have complete required fields.
abort_criteria: Can't load CPS materials via vm
U-SH05.exit_gate: All 185 materials validated. Outliers documented. No material has kc1.1=0 or NaN.

U-SH06.title: CORS integration test for Fusion add-in panel
U-SH06.description: Write a supertest-based test that starts the Express server and sends a request with no origin (simulating file:// protocol from Fusion CEF). Verify Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is returned.
U-SH06.exit_gate: CORS test passes. Both null-origin and localhost origins return correct headers.

U-SH07.title: Expand G-code test fixtures from real program corpus
U-SH07.description: Select 20 additional programs from the 2,883-program corpus (4 per controller: Haas, Okuma, Hurco, Mazak, Siemens). Add to fixtures. Write tests that pipeline-process each successfully.
U-SH07.exit_gate: 20 new fixtures added. All process through pipeline without NaN or crash.

U-SH08.title: PPG page 5-step wizard shell
U-SH08.description: Refactor PostProcessorGeneratorPage.tsx to add a 5-step wizard mode alongside the existing 6-tab mode (toggle between them). Steps: 1.Machine 2.Material 3.Tools 4.CAM 5.Generate. Step indicator at top. WorkspacePrimitives layout.
U-SH08.exit_gate: Wizard renders. Steps navigate forward/back. Existing tab mode still works via toggle.

U-SH09.title: WorkspaceHero + SummaryTiles for PPG wizard
U-SH09.description: Hero: 'Post Processor Generator' title. 4 SummaryTiles: Machine (selected or 'Pick a machine'), Material (selected or 'Pick material'), Tools (count), Status (configuring/ready/generating).
U-SH09.exit_gate: Hero renders. Tiles update reactively as user configures. Status tile shows 'Ready' when machine+material+tool set.

U-SH10.title: Wizard step validation + progressive disclosure
U-SH10.description: Step 1 (Machine) must be completed before Step 2 unlocks. Step 2 (Material) before Step 3. Incomplete steps show disabled 'Next' button with hint. Completed steps show green checkmark.
abort_criteria: User can skip to Step 5 without setting machine
U-SH10.exit_gate: Steps enforce linear flow. User can go back to any completed step. Hints guide next action.

U-SH23.description: Run every PPG test file, MOAT regression, CPS standalone, CPS simulator, data validation, E2E. Target: 1600+ tests, 0 failures.
